_comment: Single-target intermittent-clutter scenario for the tracker stress test (C.3). One target at stable high-SNR amplitude crosses a fixed range band that is periodically covered by clutter bursts. The clutter is expressed as a stack of ClutterRegion entries each restricted to its own [frame_min, frame_max) window, producing roughly 10-frame ON / 10-frame OFF cycles in the 4-6 m range band. When ON, the clutter spawns spurious detections that compete with the true target for association; when OFF, the field is clean. This exercises (a) the tracker's M-of-N confirmation, since false tracks born from clutter detections must die before reaching 'confirmed', and (b) the gating logic, since the true track should reject in-gate clutter detections when its predicted position differs.
